key_terms.الْحَاقَّةُ: The Reality; The Striking Calamity; A title for the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic term Al-Haqqah mean?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, Al-Haqqah is viewed as a profound declaration of divine certainty, emphasizing that the Day of Judgment is not merely a future event but an established reality that will strip away all illusions of worldly power. The chapter's vivid imagery of the destruction of past civilizations, such as 'Aad and Thamud, serves as a historical precedent for the ultimate accountability of all humanity before Allah. This narrative reinforces the Shia concept of 'Adl (Divine Justice), illustrating how the righteous and the wicked will be separated by the undeniable weight of their deeds.
